name: Survey Design
description: Design of sampling frames, questionnaire schedules, stratification, and estimation procedures for socio-economic surveys.

levels.Beginner: Understands questionnaire terminology and basic sampling frame concepts.
levels.Intermediate: Capable of designing multi-stage survey schedules and pre-testing instruments.
levels.Advanced: Designs complex national surveys, weight calibration, and non-sampling error modeling.

name: Sampling Techniques
description: Probability sampling, two-stage stratified sampling (FSU/SSU), cluster sampling, and variance estimation for NSS surveys.

levels.Beginner: Calculates simple random sampling and basic stratification weights.
levels.Intermediate: Implements two-stage sampling designs and circular systematic sampling.
levels.Advanced: Optimizes sample allocation across sub-strata, jackknife variance, and small area estimation.

name: Statistical Analysis & Inference
description: Hypothesis testing, descriptive and inferential statistics, variance estimation, regression modeling, and statistical significance in national sample datasets.

levels.Beginner: Understands central tendency, dispersion, p-values, and basic confidence intervals.
levels.Intermediate: Conducts multivariate regression, ANOVA, and weighted parametric and non-parametric tests.
levels.Advanced: Designs econometric models, time-series forecasting, and robust causal inference frameworks.

name: National Accounts & GDP Compilation
description: System of National Accounts (SNA 2008), Gross Value Added (GVA), base year revisions, and supply-use tables.

levels.Beginner: Understands GDP, GVA, and primary/secondary/tertiary sector aggregations.
levels.Intermediate: Compiles quarterly GVA estimates and institutional sector accounts.
levels.Advanced: Develops supply-use tables, double deflation methodologies, and base year revisions.

name: Price Statistics & Index Numbers
description: Consumer Price Index (CPI-Rural/Urban/Combined), WPI, Laspeyres formula, chaining, and geometric mean aggregation.

levels.Beginner: Computes elementary price relatives and basic Laspeyres indices.
levels.Intermediate: Manages price quotation validation, outlet substitution, and weight updates.
levels.Advanced: Constructs core inflation models, hedonic regression for quality changes, and index linkage.

name: Labour Statistics & PLFS
description: Periodic Labour Force Survey (PLFS) concepts, Usual Status (ps+ss), Current Weekly Status (CWS), LFPR, WPR, and UR.

levels.Beginner: Defines Labour Force Participation Rate, Worker Population Ratio, and Unemployment Rate.
levels.Intermediate: Extracts and analyzes PLFS household and person records according to activity statuses.
levels.Advanced: Evaluates informal economy employment, transition matrices, and multidimensional labour dynamics.

name: Agricultural Statistics
description: Crop estimation surveys (GCES), land-use classifications, cost of cultivation, and livestock censuses.

levels.Beginner: Understands crop yield estimation and acreage reporting protocols.
levels.Intermediate: Analyzes crop-cutting experiment data and agro-climatic trends.
levels.Advanced: Integrates remote sensing/GIS with crop cutting experiments for objective crop forecasting.

name: Industrial Statistics & ASI
description: Annual Survey of Industries (ASI), Index of Industrial Production (IIP), NIC classifications, and factory sector aggregates.

levels.Beginner: Navigates National Industrial Classification (NIC) and ASI schedule blocks.
levels.Intermediate: Validates balance sheet blocks, invested capital, and net value added computations.
levels.Advanced: Constructs IIP monthly baskets, detects reporting anomalies in industrial units, and tracks factory growth.

name: SDG Indicators & NIF
description: National Indicator Framework (NIF) for Sustainable Development Goals, baseline monitoring, and metadata tracking.

levels.Beginner: Identifies 17 SDGs and core MoSPI National Indicator Framework guidelines.
levels.Intermediate: Calculates normalized indicator scores and sub-national performance indices.
levels.Advanced: Designs localization frameworks and advises state departments on data gap remediation.

name: Metadata Standards & DDI
description: Statistical Data and Metadata eXchange (SDMX), Data Documentation Initiative (DDI), codebooks, and data dictionaries.

levels.Beginner: Understands the necessity of standardized variable naming and codebooks.
levels.Intermediate: Authors XML/JSON metadata catalogs conforming to DDI and NADA formats.
levels.Advanced: Implements automated SDMX data pipelines and harmonizes cross-survey registries.

name: Data Quality Frameworks
description: UN Fundamental Principles of Official Statistics, National Quality Assurance Framework (NQAF), validation rules.

levels.Beginner: Understands integrity, objectivity, and transparency standards in statistical releases.
levels.Intermediate: Audits survey returns against range, logical consistency, and imputation checks.
levels.Advanced: Architects automated NQAF compliance dashboards and organizational data audits.

name: SQL & Relational Databases
description: Relational data querying, multi-table joins on census/survey microdata, window functions, and indexing.

levels.Beginner: Executes SELECT, WHERE, GROUP BY, and basic inner/left joins on single survey tables.
levels.Intermediate: Writes complex multi-table joins, subqueries, and aggregation over weighted survey strata.
levels.Advanced: Optimizes execution plans, designs dimensional schemas for time-series data, and writes analytic window functions.

name: Python for Statistical Computing
description: Pandas, NumPy, Scipy, data cleaning, automated statistical pipeline scripting, and API integration.

levels.Beginner: Loads CSV/Excel files into pandas DataFrames and runs summary statistics.
levels.Intermediate: Cleans large microdata sets, handles missing values, and builds data transformation workflows.
levels.Advanced: Develops end-to-end automated pipelines, custom statistical packages, and high-performance vectorized operations.

name: R Programming & Econometrics
description: Survey package in R, tidyverse, econometric regression modeling, time-series forecasting (ARIMA), and markdown reports.

levels.Beginner: Uses ggplot2 and dplyr for exploratory analysis of tabular data.
levels.Intermediate: Applies the 'survey' library for complex weighted sampling variance and regression.
levels.Advanced: Builds reproducible Shiny analytical dashboards and automated quarterly report pipelines.

name: Data Visualization & Dashboards
description: Translating statistical findings into interactive charts, thematic maps, executive dashboards, and infographics.

levels.Beginner: Generates standard bar, line, and pie charts with clean labels and titles.
levels.Intermediate: Builds interactive multi-filter dashboards and choropleth regional heatmaps.
levels.Advanced: Designs cognitive-friendly executive scorecards adhering to national data presentation standards.

name: AI & Machine Learning in Statistics
description: Supervised/unsupervised learning, outlier and anomaly detection in enterprise census data, NLP for text coding.

levels.Beginner: Understands distinction between rule-based validation and machine learning models.
levels.Intermediate: Applies isolation forests and clustering to detect fake or anomalous survey responses.
levels.Advanced: Deploys production NLP classifiers for automated NIC/NCO occupation text categorization.

name: GIS & Spatial Statistics
description: Geographical Information Systems, QGIS, spatial autocorrelation, geofencing primary sampling units (PSUs).

levels.Beginner: Overlays survey coordinates on district administrative boundary shapefiles.
levels.Intermediate: Performs spatial buffer analysis and detects spatial autocorrelation (Moran's I).
levels.Advanced: Automates satellite imagery feature extraction and spatial interpolation for unobserved clusters.

name: APIs & System Integration
description: RESTful API consumption, statistical microservices, JSON/XML payload serialization, and secure endpoint integration.

levels.Beginner: Makes GET requests to public statistical data portals (Open Government Data - OGD).
levels.Intermediate: Builds REST endpoints for publishing statistical indicators to line ministries.
levels.Advanced: Architects high-throughput microservices with rate limiting, OAuth 2.0, and API gateway telemetry.

name: Cybersecurity & Data Protection
description: Securing national statistical repositories, role-based access control, cryptographic hashing, and threat prevention.

levels.Beginner: Follows password hygiene, phishing defense, and endpoint device security protocols.
levels.Intermediate: Implements role-based access controls, database audit logging, and encrypted backups.
levels.Advanced: Conducts vulnerability assessments and designs defense-in-depth architecture for national servers.

name: Data Privacy & Anonymization
description: Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act 2023, Statistical Confidentiality, k-anonymity, differential privacy.

levels.Beginner: Understands legal obligation of respondent confidentiality under the Collection of Statistics Act.
levels.Intermediate: Applies cell suppression and top/bottom coding on public use microdata files (PUMFs).
levels.Advanced: Implements formal differential privacy noise mechanisms and re-identification risk audits.

name: Digital Public Infrastructure & Gov Cloud
description: India Stack, MeghRaj cloud, Digilocker, e-Sign, and National Data Governance Framework Policy (NDGFP).

levels.Beginner: Understands the core components of India Stack and Government e-Marketplace (GeM).
levels.Intermediate: Integrates applications with MeghRaj cloud and Aadhaar-based e-Sign protocols.
levels.Advanced: Architects federated data exchange platforms under the National Data Governance Framework.

name: Leadership & Decision Making
description: Strategic direction, evidence-informed policy leadership, crisis management, and inspiring inter-disciplinary teams.

levels.Beginner: Demonstrates accountability and aligns personal tasks with divisional mandates.
levels.Intermediate: Leads field teams during census operations and arbitrates conflicting data interpretations.
levels.Advanced: Formulates institutional statistical vision, steers policy advisory committees, and drives reform.

name: Project Management in Official Operations
description: Gantt charts, critical path method, budget tracking for nationwide field surveys, and vendor/enumerator monitoring.

levels.Beginner: Tracks survey milestone checklists and flags operational delays promptly.
levels.Intermediate: Manages operational budgets, enumerator rosters, and multi-round survey schedules.
levels.Advanced: Directs nationwide census lifecycle from gazette notification to data dissemination.

name: Communication & Statistical Dissemination
description: Clear presentation of statistical trends to ministers, media, academia, and the public without misleading narratives.

levels.Beginner: Drafts clear technical notes and responses to parliamentary questions.
levels.Intermediate: Presents survey findings in press briefings and prepares executive summaries.
levels.Advanced: Masters crisis communication regarding statistical revisions and leads high-level stakeholder discourse.

name: Ethics & Professional Integrity
description: Unbiased data reporting, resistance to external pressures, adherence to ISI Declaration on Professional Ethics.

levels.Beginner: Demonstrates transparency and reports discrepancies without concealment.
levels.Intermediate: Enforces objective standards in enumeration and protects field staff from bias.
levels.Advanced: Champions institutional autonomy and ethical governance across the statistical system.
